question: Should Vitis vinifera be recommended for: symptomatic relief of non-complicated chronic venous insufficiency (mild oedema, heaviness, tingling in the legs)?

records.notes: Systematic review of red vine leaf extract (AS 195) for chronic venous insufficiency concludes a beneficial therapeutic role in reducing leg symptoms, but the authors state further high-quality trials are still required to provide strong evidence, and the EMA/HMPC monograph reflects this qualified evidence base.
records.source_title: Red vine leaf extract (AS 195) can improve some signs and symptoms of chronic venous insufficiency, a systematic review
records.target_indication: symptomatic relief of non-complicated chronic venous insufficiency (mild oedema, heaviness, tingling in the legs)
records.primary_outcome: symptomatic relief of non-complicated chronic venous insufficiency (mild oedema, heaviness, tingling in the legs)
